command:
mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api && cat > /opt/inventory-api/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json
import http.server
import socketserver

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "C300", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 8},
]

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok"})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json(200, {"items": INVENTORY})
        else:
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with socketserver.TCPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler) as httpd:
        httpd.serve_forever()
PYEOF

command:
cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-api <<'EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-api"
description="Inventory API service"
command="/usr/bin/python3"
command_args="/opt/inventory-api/app.py"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"
error_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"

start_stop_daemon_args="--oom-score-adj -1000"

depend() {
    need net
    after firewall
}
EOF
chmod +x /etc/init.d/inventory-api
rc-update add inventory-api default
rc-service inventory-api start
sleep 1

echo ---
cat /run/inventory-api.pid
echo ---
